# Psych Central

> > Psych Central is a comprehensive mental health resource providing evidence-based information on psychiatric disorders, mental health conditions, treatments, and support resources.

Psych Central offers detailed guides and resource hubs covering major mental health conditions including ADHD, depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, PTSD, and schizophrenia, along with information on personality disorders, substance use disorders, and specialized conditions. The site combines clinical disorder information with practical treatment guidance and coping strategies.

## Key Topics

- ADHD
- Depression
- Anxiety Disorder
- Bipolar Disorder
- PTSD
- Borderline Personality Disorder
- Schizophrenia
- Narcissistic Personality Disorder
- Dissociative Identity Disorder
- Substance Use Disorder
- DSM-5 Diagnosis
- Mental Health Conditions
- Therapy Resources
- Treatment Overview
- Psychiatric Disorders

## Core Mental Health Conditions

- [Mental disorders and mental illness](https://www.psychcentral.com): PsychCentral homepage covering ADHD, bipolar disorder, depression, PTSD
- [Mental Health Conditions | Psych Central](https://www.psychcentral.com/conditions): Directory of mental health conditions with treatments and resources
- [ADHD: Resource Hub](https://www.psychcentral.com/adhd): ADHD resource hub with tips, insights, and symptom management resources
- [Depression: Resource Hub](https://www.psychcentral.com/depression): Depression resource guide with treatments, support, and crisis resources
- [Anxiety: Resource Hub](https://www.psychcentral.com/anxiety): Anxiety disorder resource hub with guidance and support information
- [Bipolar Disorder: Resource Hub](https://www.psychcentral.com/bipolar): Bipolar disorder resource hub covering symptoms, treatments, and management
- [PTSD: Resource Hub](https://www.psychcentral.com/ptsd): PTSD resource hub covering symptoms, causes, treatments, and recovery
- [Schizophrenia: Resource Hub](https://www.psychcentral.com/schizophrenia): Schizophrenia resource guide for symptom management and support resources

## Personality Disorders & Specialized Conditions

- [Borderline Personality Disorder: All You Need to Know | Psych Central](https://www.psychcentral.com/disorders/borderline-personality-disorder): BPD symptoms, causes, DBT therapy, and treatment management guide
- [What Is Narcissism and What Causes It?](https://www.psychcentral.com/disorders/narcissistic-personality-disorder): Narcissistic personality disorder diagnosis, symptoms, and causes
- [Antisocial Personality Disorder: Causes, Symptoms, and More](https://www.psychcentral.com/disorders/antisocial-personality-disorder): ASPD causes, symptoms, and cluster B personality disorder overview
- [Is Dissociative Identity Disorder Real?](https://www.psychcentral.com/disorders/dissociative-identity-disorder): DID symptoms, myths, and dissociative disorder education resource

## Anxiety Disorders & Symptom Guides

- [Agoraphobia Symptoms: Physical, Mental, Behavioral, and More](https://www.psychcentral.com/anxiety/agoraphobia-symptoms): Agoraphobia anxiety disorder symptoms and coping strategies guide
- [The 12 Symptoms of a Panic Attack](https://www.psychcentral.com/anxiety/panic-attack-symptoms): Panic attack emotional, cognitive, physical symptoms and long-term effects

## Child & Adolescent Mental Health

- [Childhood/Teenage ADHD: Symptoms, Causes, Treatment](https://www.psychcentral.com/childhood-adhd/childhood-adhd): Childhood and teenage ADHD symptoms, causes, and treatment guide
- [What Are the Symptoms of ODD? | Psych Central](https://www.psychcentral.com/disorders/oppositional-defiant-disorder-symptoms): ODD symptoms in children and adolescents with DSM-5 diagnostic criteria

## Disorder Reference & Classification

- [Mental Disorders: What Are the Types of Mental Health Conditions?](https://www.psychcentral.com/disorders/disorders): Comprehensive overview of mental health disorder types per DSM-5

## Optional

- [Substance Use Disorder and Addiction: Symptoms, Treatment & Resources](https://www.psychcentral.com/addictions): Guide to substance use disorder, addiction symptoms, and treatment options
- [Symptoms and Causes of Adjustment Disorder I Psych Central](https://www.psychcentral.com/disorders/adjustment-disorder-symptoms): Adjustment disorder symptoms, causes, and diagnostic criteria overview
- [Symptoms of Narcolepsy I Psych Central](https://www.psychcentral.com/disorders/narcolepsy-symptoms): Narcolepsy sleep disorder symptoms and neurological overview
